title.en: Publish the blocked day-4 real-learning QA report
title.zh: 发布第 4 天真实学习验收受阻报告

purpose.en: Publish a truthful bilingual administrator Project report for the August 24 real-user run after production evidence showed the Listening repair passed but real human microphone input was unavailable.
purpose.zh: 根据 8 月 24 日真实生产证据发布如实的双语管理员项目报告：听力修复通过，但真实人声麦克风输入不可用。

en: Add the August 24 Project report with anonymized production evidence, per-language plans, measured status, deep-focus skills, scores, persisted logs, and blockers.
Record the successful Listening repair deployment and explicitly avoid claiming a full four-language pass.
Direct the next run to resume from the blocked English speaking step when real voice input is restored.
zh: 新增 8 月 24 日项目报告，包含匿名化生产证据、逐语言计划、实测状态、深度技能、分数、持久日志与受阻项。
记录听力修复成功部署，并明确不声称四语全量通过。
指示真实语音输入恢复后从受阻的英语口语步骤继续。

en: Administrator Project report for 2026-08-24; no learning, identity, commerce, reward, or ledger runtime behavior.
zh: 2026-08-24 管理员项目报告；不改变学习、身份、商业、奖励或账本运行行为。

en: Append one immutable bilingual Project QA report to the runtime document source.
Preserve the prior Listening implementation and regression tests unchanged.
Describe unmeasured or unexecuted acceptance work as blocked or incomplete instead of estimating durations or scores.
zh: 向运行文档源追加一条不可变双语项目 QA 报告。
保持上一版听力实现与回归测试不变。
未测量或未执行的验收项一律标记为受阻或未完成，不估算时长或分数。

en: The prior fix passed production build, sensitive-data scan, Worker artifact validation, TypeScript, all 352 automated tests, and all 62 tracked D1 migrations.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature, and eleven SmartLingo contracts passed; WebKit verified 260/260 combinations across 26 routes, two interface languages, and five viewports.

Real Chrome verified the production English Listening direction, target-language tiles, correct feedback, 1/10-to-2/10 counter advance, persisted vocabulary/reading log, zero console errors, and the microphone blocker.
zh: 上一修复已通过生产构建、敏感信息扫描、Worker 产物校验、TypeScript、全部 352 项自动化测试及全部 62 个受跟踪 D1 迁移。
共享规则、架构、基础功能及 SmartLingo 十一个共享合约通过；WebKit 在 26 条路由、两种界面语言与五种视口的 260/260 组合中通过。
真实 Chrome 已核对生产英语听力方向、目标语言词块、正确反馈、1/10 至 2/10 题号推进、词汇/阅读持久日志、零控制台错误及麦克风受阻项。

en: Japanese, Spanish, and Italian acceptance plus the remaining English Course, Play, Everyday, duration, score, and ledger checks remain blocked until real human microphone input is available.
zh: 在真实人声麦克风输入可用前，日语、西班牙语、意大利语验收及英语剩余课程、Play、生活口语、时长、分数与账本检查均保持受阻。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's Chinese interface, Clerk-linked learner identity, official 4,320-sentence catalog, signed-in progress ownership, and existing Sprint cross-language behavior.
No other portfolio site, database binding, credential, payment, referral, certificate, reward, or leaderboard resource is changed.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 中文界面、Clerk 关联学习者身份、官方 4,320 句目录、登录进度归属及现有今日速成跨语言行为。
不修改其他组合站点、数据库绑定、凭据、支付、推荐、证书、奖励或排行榜资源。
